summary: Constructor for a replay/VCR playback-controls menu object. Calls ConstructorInitVTable, installs the vtable off_5A6B20, stores a mode selector at this+0xEC, and when the mode is 480 populates a linked list with playback command entries (Begin, play, stop, forward/reverse scan, play back, bookmarks). Returns this.

operations.description: Run base constructor initialization ConstructorInitVTable with arguments (1, -1).
Store the mode selector argument: this[59] (this+0xEC) = a2.
Guard: only when a2 == 480 does the function populate the playback command list; other mode values skip population entirely.
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(&off_5C7364, -1): insert the non-string data entry at 0x005C7364.
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aReverseScanFas, -1): insert the 'Reverse Scan Fast' command entry (string at 0x005C7350).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aReverseScan, -1): insert the 'Reverse Scan' command entry (string at 0x005C7340).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aPlaybackwards, -1): insert the 'Play Backwards' command entry (string at 0x005C7330).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aStop, -1): insert the 'Stop' command entry (string at 0x005C7328).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aPlay, -1): insert the 'Play' command entry (string at 0x005C7320).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aForwardScan, -1): insert the 'Forward Scan' command entry (string at 0x005C7310).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aForwardScanFas, -1): insert the 'Forward Scan Fast' command entry (string at 0x005C72FC).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aDropBookmark, -1): insert the 'Drop Bookmark' command entry (string at 0x005C72EC).
LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation(aRemoveBookmark, -1): insert the 'Remove Bookmark' command entry (string at 0x005C72DC).

unresolved: Meaning of the mode literal 480 is caller-defined; it selects which command set this menu object populates.
off_5C7364 is a non-string data pointer inserted into the same list; its role within the command list is unknown.
Exact menu framework consuming the constructed command list is unknown.
